# TorBox Rust SDK

Async Rust client for the [TorBox API](https://api-docs.torbox.app) (reqwest + tokio). Generated from the
[OpenAPI spec](https://api.torbox.app/openapi.json) and published automatically when the API changes.

```bash
cargo add torbox@9.3.2026112508
```

## Quick start

```rust
use torbox::apis::{torrents_api, user_api};

let client = torbox::Client::new(std::env::var("TORBOX_API_KEY")?);   // https://torbox.app/settings
let me = torbox::send(user_api::get_user_data(&client.config, Default::default())).await?;
println!("{:?}", me.data);

let params = torrents_api::CreateTorrentParams { magnet: Some("magnet:?xt=urn:btih:...".into()), ..Default::default() };
torbox::send(torrents_api::create_torrent(&client.config, params)).await?;
```

Each API group is a module in `torbox::apis` (`torrents_api`, `usenet_api`, `web_downloads_api`, `user_api`, ...),
each operation a function named after its `operationId`; `docs/` lists them.

## Authentication

The client sends the key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. The download link endpoints take it as `token`:

```rust
let p = torrents_api::RequestTorrentDownloadLinkParams { token: client.api_key().into(), torrent_id: 123, file_id: Some(0), ..Default::default() };
let link = torbox::send(torrents_api::request_torrent_download_link(&client.config, p)).await?;
```

## Pagination

```rust
let all = torbox::paginate(100, |offset, limit| {
    let config = client.config.clone();
    async move {
        let p = torrents_api::GetTorrentListParams { offset: Some(offset), limit: Some(limit), ..Default::default() };
        let page = torbox::send(torrents_api::get_torrent_list(&config, p)).await?;
        Ok(page.data.unwrap_or_default())
    }
}).await?;
```

## Errors

`torbox::send` checks the `{success, error, detail, data}` envelope: error statuses and `success: false` become
`TorBoxError { status, error, detail, data }`.

```rust
match torbox::send(call).await {
    Err(e) if e.error.as_deref() == Some("RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED") => { /* ... */ }
    Err(e) => eprintln!("{} {:?}: {}", e.status.unwrap_or(0), e.error, e.detail),
    Ok(resp) => { /* resp.data */ }
}
```

Request validation errors (`422`) have `error == Some("VALIDATION_ERROR")`. Error codes:
[api-docs.torbox.app/docs/errors](https://api-docs.torbox.app/docs/errors).

## Retries and timeouts

`429` and `503` are retried (default 3 times), waiting for `Retry-After` or backing off exponentially (file uploads
are streamed and not retried). Each attempt times out after 30 s.

```rust
let client = torbox::Client::builder(key).timeout(Duration::from_secs(10)).max_retries(5).build();
```

TLS: `native-tls` by default, or `default-features = false, features = ["rustls"]`.
